reason: I already take magnesium at night at home, and I reorder my usual brand when it runs out. The on-the-go sachet solves a problem I don't have.
objection: I don't need magnesium to travel with me, and I already have a brand I trust and reorder. Why switch for a sachet?
would_change_my_mind: If I traveled a lot and my usual brand had no travel option, or if it were clearly cheaper than what I pay now for the same dose.
